name: Autonauts
description: Build a colony with friends. The Autonauts co-op mod lets several players share one world: the host runs it, and joiners walk, build, craft and teach bots in it.

setup.title: Autonauts
setup.detail: Install Autonauts from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it, with its BepInEx loader, in the game's folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts it and its BepInEx loader in the game's folder and keeps it up to date.
Press Play, then load or start a world. Press F8 and choose Host this world.
Invite your Steam friends from the window that opens (F8 then Invite Steam friends opens it again). Going back to the main menu ends the session for everyone.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, then press Play and stay on the main menu.
Accept the host's Steam invite, or right-click the host in Steam and choose Join Game.
Without Steam: press F8, type the host's IP and join (the host must open TCP port 27015).

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: The host runs the world and friends join through Steam, or by IP. Everyone needs the same version of the mod and of the game.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod and its loader in the game's folder and updates it when a new version is released.

items.name: One colony
items.detail: Joiners walk, pick up, build, craft and manage inventories in the host's world.

items.name: Bots
items.detail: Joiners can teach and run bots; others see who is programming a bot.
